description: This file defines APIs and data structures for managing XHosts and their IP addresses in a Data Model Library, including functions for retrieving, setting, validating, and committing host and IP address data.

methods.name: XHosts_GetParamUlongValue
methods.description: Retrieves a ULONG parameter value for the XHosts object.

methods.name: XHost_GetEntryCount
methods.description: Returns the number of XHost entries.

methods.name: XHost_GetEntry
methods.description: Gets a specific XHost entry by index.

methods.name: XHost_IsUpdated
methods.description: Checks if an XHost entry has been updated.

methods.name: XHost_GetParamBoolValue
methods.description: Retrieves a boolean parameter value for an XHost.

methods.name: XHost_GetParamIntValue
methods.description: Retrieves an integer parameter value for an XHost.

methods.name: XHost_GetParamStringValue
methods.description: Retrieves a string parameter value for an XHost.

methods.name: XHost_SetParamStringValue
methods.description: Sets a string parameter value for an XHost.

methods.name: XHost_Validate
methods.description: Validates changes made to an XHost entry before commit.

methods.name: XHost_Commit
methods.description: Commits changes to an XHost entry.

methods.name: XHost_Rollback
methods.description: Rolls back uncommitted changes to an XHost entry.

methods.name: XHost_IPv4Address_GetEntryCount
methods.description: Returns the count of IPv4 addresses associated with an XHost.

methods.name: XHost_IPv4Address_GetEntry
methods.description: Retrieves a specific IPv4 address entry.

methods.name: XHost_IPv4Address_GetParamStringValue
methods.description: Gets a string value of an IPv4 address parameter.

methods.name: XHost_IPv6Address_GetEntryCount
methods.description: Returns the count of IPv6 addresses associated with an XHost.

methods.name: XHost_IPv6Address_GetEntry
methods.description: Retrieves a specific IPv6 address entry.

methods.name: XHost_IPv6Address_GetParamStringValue
methods.description: Gets a string value of an IPv6 address parameter.
